description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Change name, description, street address and its map point, public contacts, cancellation rules or automatic confirmation. Pass lat and lng with a new address when you know them; without them the old map point is dropped. A new name for a live business is reviewed by Awning first: customers keep seeing the current name until the team approves it, and the response says so under rename — tell the owner. Sending the current name again withdraws a new name that is waiting; a change of letter case only goes through at once. What is sent replaces what is there. Confirm with the owner first.

business_id.description: Only needed if you manage several businesses

contacts.description: Public contacts customers see: phone, whatsapp, telegram, instagram, website, email (public_email means the same as email). An empty string clears one; the ones not sent stay as they are.
